function t1.value12(p9)
	local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if t1.value9 then
		local t1value9 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(t1.value9)
		local v46 = t1value9

		if t1value9 then
			v46 = t1value9.Character

			if v46 then
				v46 = t1value9.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
		end

		if v46 then
			if p9 then
				CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = t1value9.Character.Humanoid

				return
			end

			CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid

			return
		end

		print("Selected player not available or out of game.")

		return
	end

	print("No player selected!")
end
function t1.value13()
	local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local v48 = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	if v48 and v48:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local HumanoidRootPart = v48.HumanoidRootPart

		if t1.value9 then
			local t1value9 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(t1.value9)
			local v51 = t1value9

			if v51 then
				v51 = t1value9.Character

				if v51 then
					v51 = t1value9.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				end
			end

			if v51 then
				HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = t1value9.Character.Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
				t1.value10 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					local value11 = t1.value11

					if value11 then
						value11 = t1value9

						if value11 then
							value11 = t1value9.Character

							if value11 then
								value11 = t1value9.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
							end
						end
					end

					if value11 then
						HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = t1value9.Character.Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)

						return
					end

					t1.value10:Disconnect()
				end)

				return
			end

			print("Target player not found or not in the game.")

			return
		end

		print("No player selected!")
	end
end

function t1.value15()
	local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local HumanoidRootPart = (LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()):FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if HumanoidRootPart and t1.value9 then
		local t1value9 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(t1.value9)
		local v57 = t1value9

		if t1value9 then
			v57 = t1value9.Character

			if v57 then
				v57 = t1value9.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
		end

		if v57 then
			local HumanoidRootPart2 = t1value9.Character.HumanoidRootPart
			local HumanoidRootPartCFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame

			HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
			wait(1.5)
			HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPartCFrame

			return
		end

		print("Selected player not found or not in the game.")

		return
	end

	print("No player or HumanoidRootPart found!")
end

				v67 = t1value9.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
